newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Berjaya gets Ghana lottery contract.
newsitem.headline: Berjaya gets Ghana lottery contract.

text.p: Malaysia's Berjaya Group Bhd said on Monday that its Berjaya Lottery Management (HK) Ltd unit has been appointed as sole consultant and project manager to Ghana's Department of National Lotteries.

In a statement, Berjaya said its unit will assist the department in restructuring and improving its operation and administration of its nationwide lotteries for a period of 10 years, with an option to extend for a further five years.
The Ghanaian department is seeking "a more efficient and diversified system to maximise its revenue", the statement said.

As part of its contract, Berjaya will promote new lottery games, digit-number games and other new lotto games and will supply and install equipment to computerise the Ghanaian department's operation and administration of the lotteries business.
Berjaya will be the sole supplier of the lottery systems, product and tickets on all the departement's business.
All equipment related to the computerised system will be leased to the department by Berjaya Lottery, it said.
In consideration for the equipment and services, Berjaya Lottery will receive a fee equivalent to 15 percent of the gross monthly revenue generated from the department's business.
Details on the department's monthly revenues were not available.
